svg.desc: The mala on a departed person's frame: marigolds hung beneath it, tied at its sides, open at the top - never a closed ring - so it reads as hung on the frame rather than worn as a wreath. Its anchor is the frame's centre and its units the round frames': it hangs on the frame, never on the person and never towards anybody else. Pulled further out and down from the opening (#257 round 2, finding 2) so it clears even the thicker photograph mount rather than tucking behind it. Original f-tree work, MIT.
